summary: Tested iteration 46 end to end (backend + UI). Covered: technical errors hidden from members (Radar dashboard/runs, Radar page, history table, pack errors), the Admin 'Journal des erreurs' categories and the fixable flag, strength levers ('Comment gagner des points ?') with follow toggle and lever_stats, Radar save/unsave and the learning line, the Dashboard counters with Radar items, and applications interviews_count. Found 1 real bug: POST /radar/offers/{id}/save returned 404 on the first save of any offer (projection returned an empty dict). I fixed it and retested. Everything else works as specified.

minor.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: find_one projection {'_id':0,'saved':1} returns {} (falsy) for offers that never had 'saved', so every first save returned 404 'Offre introuvable'. Added 'id':1 to the projection (radar.py save_offer).

Any id matching [a-z_]{2,20} is accepted even if it is not in the member's lever catalog (e.g. 'zzz'). It increments lever_stats.followed, and the next GET /strength immediately marks it 'realised' (done+1, gain counted) because it is not in the current items. This pollutes the anonymous stats. Validate lever_id against levers(profile,res) ids (or a static catalog id set).
The 'Génération interrompue (redémarrage du serveur)' pack errors are written without PE.log_error, so they never reach the Admin journal.

'saved' includes saved offers that were later ignored (status 'ignoree'); they still count in the Dashboard stat-saved/stat-total. top_a is capped at 20, so Dashboard 'Priorité A' undercounts members with more than 20 Radar A offers.

ui_bugs.issue: Neutral text uses feminine 'n'a pas pu être générée' for every tab label, including masculine ones (CV ATS, CV humain, Suivi & agenda).
A pack with status 'error' still shows the title 'Analyse en cours…'.

integration_issues.issue: _member_run drops the whole 'errors' map, so useful non-technical notices (errors.cv 'Ajoutez votre CV…', errors.limite) are no longer shown anywhere. skipped_limit is still shown in radar-last-run. Consider a whitelisted 'notices' field.
dashboard-radar-row-* links to /careeros/radar without anchoring or highlighting the clicked offer.

issues: Impact line uses a decimal point ('Leadership : 9.0 → 15/15'), while the rest of the UI uses a French comma ('+2,5 pts').
Non-portal cards show the raw kind ('pack') next to the name because kind_label falls back to the raw kind.
Orange 'À postuler rapidement' badge and faded 'Lecture fragile/bloquée' chips have low contrast on light background.

action_items: Validate lever_id against the member's actual lever ids in the follow endpoint (avoid polluting lever_stats)
Log startup-recovery pack failures to PE.log_error
Exclude status 'ignoree' from dashboard 'saved' (or unsave on ignore)
Optional: expose non-technical run notices (missing CV / daily limit) to members via a whitelisted field
Optional: gender-neutral part-error text; pack title when status=error; French decimal in lever impact
critical_code_review_comments: radar.py is 957 lines and router.py is 640 lines: consider splitting radar.py (endpoints vs run engine)

portal_errors.log_error stores exception text (message) after only stripping query strings. Pack exceptions could contain offer/CV fragments; consider truncating to the exception type plus a generic message.
strength_follow upsert on {user_id, lever_id} overwrites a previously 'done' record when the member re-follows, losing the realised history.
